LESSON: WRITING 13.4.1 SPELLING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.4: Writing 13.4.1 Spelling

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 13.4.1 Spelling. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we write words correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify homophones, words with double consonants and words with double vowels correctly
2. spell homophones, words with double consonants and words with double vowels correctly
3. uses homophones, words with double consonants and words with double vowels in sentences correctly

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 13.4.1 SPELLING
This lesson teaches Writing 13.4.1 Spelling for Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify homophones, words with double consonants and words with double vowels correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. spell homophones, words with double consonants and words with double vowels correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. uses homophones, words with double consonants and words with double vowels in sentences correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 13.4.1 Spelling using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 13.4.1 Spelling above.
2. Explain Writing 13.4.1 Spelling to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 13.4.1 Spelling.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 13.4.1 Spelling with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 13.4.1 Spelling important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we write words correctly?
2. Which words have the same pronunciation but different spelling?
3. what went well and why?
4. what did not go well and why?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify homophones, words with double consonants and words with double vowels correctly
2. spell homophones, words with double consonants and words with double vowels correctly
3. uses homophones, words with double consonants and words with double vowels in sentences correctly

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
